summary: RETEST of iteration_106 fixes (targeted, not full suite). Backend: 4/4 new pytest checks pass (overview counts exclude author-deleted posts, double-remove = single strike, clear_strikes, suspend->restore preserves 'reserved', suspended author POST /feed/posts -> 403). Manual API flow: the prohibited post was hidden_review within ~3s; after a UI appeal, admin remove rejected the open appeal and dropped the post from the appealed queue (expected). Re-appealing then worked (201) and queue?status=appealed listed it with status=removed and moderation.status=appealed. Frontend (390x844 and 360x740): no nested-<button> console errors and 0 nested buttons in the DOM. Action rows fit inside every card checked (6 at 390, 5 at 360), are icon-only at 360 and 44px tall. Subtitle 'Around Lagos' is not truncated and the emblem is hidden at 360. Search open/filter/close restores the feed and the input is empty on reopen. Compose lands on /updates with the new post first, and delete via the menu works. In /social/mine the hidden notice shows, submit stays disabled under 10 chars, and the title switches to 'Appeal sent · under review' right away and after reload. In /social/moderation the settings sheet has the labelled AI toggle and cancel works. The Appeals tab shows the quote and 'Restore' with no Remove button. The ⋯ menu hides 'Clear strikes' at 0 strikes; warn adds the '1 strike' badge and Clear strikes removes it. Restore takes the card out of the queue and the post becomes active. All fixes verified, no regressions found.

minor.issue: After a moderator removes a post (which rejects the open appeal), the author can appeal again with no limit. Appeal -> remove -> appeal can loop forever. Consider a max appeal count per post, or a cooldown.

issues: Toggle feed-mod-set-ai hit box is 46x26, below the 44pt minimum height (add hitSlop or a taller wrapper).
Seeded post 'Teak Outdoor Lounge Set (4pc)' by Casa Milano shows a garden trowel/soil photo, not furniture. The image doesn't match the item.
